_comment: Single source of truth for business details and tracking IDs. Edit, then run `npm run build`. Values marked TODO must be confirmed by the business owner before launch.
businessAddress: 1 Viaduct Road, Leeds LS4 2BG, United Kingdom
_addressParts: The same address split up for Google (structured data). Keep both in step.
legalForm: a sole trader based in the UK
_cloudinary: Customer logo files and design pictures are uploaded here with each order (unsigned upload preset; see README).
_orderWorker: The order Worker's address (worker/README.md), e.g. https://vl-orders.NAME.workers.dev. Empty: designs aren't sent to MarketCenter.
_shortLinks: Short links that send visitors to the home page tagged with where they came from, so Google Analytics can tell them apart (virtualleather.net/bio and so on). Add one here, then run the build.
_indexNowKey: Public key that lets Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow search engines know about new and changed pages at each deploy (tools/indexnow.mjs). It is meant to be public.
